title: The World Is Asking
in_plain_words: The words leave little room. About 10 bars in a hundred have nothing sung; kept songs leave 12 to 28. The song runs 291 seconds over 102 bars, and 90 of those bars belong to sung sections. Fewer lines, or a verse less, would leave room for the voice to rest.

The singing is one busyness all through. The verse's lines run 8.1 syllables and the chorus's 6.6 (close to the same). Kept songs change: a wordy verse against a chorus of few, held words, or the reverse. Lines of clearly different length in verse and chorus would give the tune that change.
